title: B Structural Volumizing and Lengthening Mascara
descriptionHtml:
✓ Clean at Sephora✓ Volumizing✓ Long-wearing✓ Lengthening✓ Hypoallergenic

What it is: A biotech-enhanced mascara that delivers 5X fanned-out volume that’s nourishing and lengthening, not clumpy or flaky.

Formulation Type: Volumizing, Curling, Lengthening


Benefits: Long-wearing


Highlighted Ingredients:
- Vegan B-Silk™: A bio-engineered polypeptide that wraps lashes in an invisible, web-like matrix for soft, flexible hold and buildable volume while strengthening lashes.

- Rice Protein: Helps to promote hair health.

- Panthenol: Derived from vitamin B5, helps to condition and nourish.


How to Use+
Suggested Usage:
-Coat lashes from root to tip and build to your desired level.
-Use the flat side to deposit pigment and the hourglass side for fanned-out volume.
-Easy to build and easy to remove.
Ingredients+
- Vegan B-Silk™: A bio-engineered polypeptide that wraps lashes in an invisible, web-like matrix for soft, flexible hold, and buildable volume while strengthening lashes.
- Rice Protein: Helps to promote hair health.
- Panthenol: Derived from vitamin B5, helps to condition and nourish.

Aqua (Water, Eau), Glyceryl Stearate, C18-36 Acid Triglyceride, Synthetic Wax, Copernicia Cerifera Cera (Copernicia Cerifera (Carnauba) Wax, Cire de Carnauba), Ricinus Communis (Castor) Seed Oil, Acrylates Copolymer, VP/Hexadecene Copolymer, Stearic Acid, Glycerin, Palmitic Acid, Sr-(Spider Polypeptide-1 Oligopeptide-178)**, Pentylene Glycol, Panthenol, Synthetic Beeswax, Hydrolyzed Rice Protein, Proline, Tocopherol, Arginine, Xanthan Gum, Octyldodecanol, Hydroxyacetophenone, Ethylhexylglycerin, Propanediol, Sodium PCA, Phenoxyethanol, Citric Acid, Potassium Sorbate, Sodium Benzoate, Sodium Hydroxide, CI 77499 (Iron Oxides), CI 77007 (Ultramarines).
** Vegan B-Silk™

The list of ingredients is subject to change. Please consult the packaging of the product purchased.
